generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
THE BIDDER SHALL SUBMIT THE TECHNICAL DETAILS OF THE SUPPLY EQUIPMENT.

technicalCriterionList.description: List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted

The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed, as a prime contractor, similar work such as Supply Erection testing and commissioning of Motor Pump sets/Electromechanical equipment of value not less than Rs. 7.87 lakhs (including GST) in the last Five years (i.e., 2021-22 ,2022-23,2023-24,2024-25, 2025-26) in any power stations.As a proof of this, the bidder should upload a work order and corresponding work done certificate issued by the Competent Authority. (Work done of previous years shall be given weight at 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year subject to maximum escalation of five Years).

The Intending Bidder should Manufacturer or authorized dealer/supplier of motor pump sets/Electro Mechanical Equipments. As a proof of this, valid Registration certificate/Authorization certificate issued by Competent Authority shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Registration certificate/Authorization certificate/PO copy if supplier

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder in his name should have achieved an average annual financial turnover of Rs. 15.74 lakhs in at least two financial years during the last Five years (i.e., 2021-22 ,2022-23,2023-24,2024-25, 2025-26). As a proof of this, the bidder shall upload the certified copy of the Profit and Loss account or turnover certificate duly certified by the chartered Accountant. (Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weight of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of financial year subject to maximum escalation of five Years).
